note: Admin-only Architecture (Modules) workspace. The platform is a set of pluggable modules, not a rigid stack. This is the guide for what exists, what is being built, and what is planned: every feature added to the platform should slot into one of these modules. Staff only.

modules.title: Game core + proof of play
modules.summary: Per-game engine + on-chain VRF dice + verifiable roll. Knows NOTHING about points, tiers, competitions. Each game is its own M1 instance (Ludo now, Ayo Olopon next, then 50+).
details: Ludo is the first M1 instance (live, on-chain dice on the ER VRF).
Scope A shipped: every human roll runs gasless on the ER VRF; computer rolls via the house key server-side.
Any seat's roll has NO offline fallback: retry x3 then pause + monitor (never fake roll).
Pluggable: the next game (Ayo Olopon) becomes its own M1 instance with the same proof-of-play contract.

modules.title: Local points (per game, PURE, on-chain)
modules.summary: Only verified gameplay + win (proof-of-play gated). No multiplier, no purchase, no bonus, no referral. Never diluted. On-chain PDA per game (seed gfgpoints + game tag). Feeds in-game levels + future untransferable level NFT. The bragging-rights source of truth.
details: On-chain: per-game points PDA, seed [gfgpoints, game_tag, player]. record_points writes ONLY the pure base win (100), never a multiplied total.
Game tag ('ludo', 'ayo_olopon') isolates each game's ledger; 50+ games each get their own.
Proof-of-play gated: a valid on-chain roll must exist for the win to bank.
No source of dilution: signup bonus, purchases, referral, giveaways NEVER land here.
Feeds local in-game levels; future: level as untransferable on-chain NFT.
Current state to change: record_points today writes the multiplied total to one gfgpoints PDA (pre-module model); this is the core M2 rework.

modules.title: Global points (3 ledgers, site-wide, decoupled from gameplay)
modules.summary: M3a Global Pure (sum of M2 local wins across all games, no multiplier, honest cross-game skill total). M3b Global Lifetime (unspendable) - every point ever earned from any source. M3c Global Spendable - the spendable split of lifetime. The 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at M3 flow-up, never on M2 or M3a.
details: M3a GLOBAL PURE: strictly the sum of M2 local wins across all games. No multiplier, no purchases, no bonus. The honest 'how good are you across the whole platform' number.
M3b GLOBAL LIFETIME (unspendable): every point ever earned from ANY source (game wins, signup bonus, giveaways, referral, sub multiplier). Permanent reputation/level number.
M3c GLOBAL SPENDABLE: the spendable split of lifetime. Purchases, Active Tier buys, comp entries, cosmetics all flow here. Goes up and down.
Active Tier 2x/3x/4x multiplier applies ONLY at M3 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), NEVER on M2 local or M3a pure.
Source-tagged: every M3 credit carries its game/event source ('Ludo', 'Ayo Olopon', 'signup_bonus', 'referral', 'giveaway').
Current state to change: today there is ONE global_points + lifetime_points on the profile and a single point_transactions ledger; this becomes the 3-ledger M3 model.

modules.title: Competitions (standalone, game-agnostic)
modules.summary: Entry config = points requirement + optional custom fields (e.g. phone number for airtime). Plugs into one / multiple / all games. Pluggable payout: airtime, escrow, manual. Runs fine with NO sponsor.
details: Game-agnostic: a competition selects which games' points count (one, several, or all), never tailored to a single game.
Entry requirements: general (points threshold) + competition-specific custom fields (e.g. phone number for airtime rewards).
Payout is pluggable: airtime (via phone field), on-chain escrow (M5), or manual. Standalone even with no sponsor.
Product build is deferred until M1-M3 ship and test; the escrow program proof (M5) already exists on devnet.
NG test-launch plan: 1-2 week launch, daily airtime to winners via the phone number collected at entry.

modules.title: Sponsor escrow (optional plugin, separate from M4)
modules.summary: Brand-funded prize pool locked on-chain BEFORE the event, 30/70 rake at settle. A competition may use M5 or not. Optional plugin, not part of the core competition flow.
details: Program proof already built + verified on devnet (Competition account, fund/close/settle/claim, 70/30 winners bucket, one active comp per sponsor).
Sponsor (brand) locks SOL on-chain before the event; winners claim gasless; platform keeps 30%.
Kept SEPARATE from M4: a competition runs without M5 (airtime / manual payout). M5 is attached only when a brand wants a guaranteed escrowed prize.
Mainnet legal framing: points entry + small fee, prizes in points, real value only via escrow with T&Cs.

modules.title: Monthly subscription (powers the multiplier)
modules.summary: The consistent-money module: a monthly subscription (Active Tier) bought from spendable points that powers the 2x/3x/4x win multiplier applied at M3 flow-up. The core recurring revenue stream.
details: Standalone module because it is the consistent money engine: 1,000 / 2,500 / 5,000 spendable per month for 2x / 3x / 4x (econ-003 settled ladder).
Multiplier applies ONLY at M3 flow-up (lifetime + spendable), never on M2 local or M3a pure. A player's pure local wins stay honest.
Build timing: EARLY, immediately after the game (M1-M3) - the platform can't launch without the monthly subscription because players expect to upgrade and get a multiplier instead of base rewards.
Future: real-money subscription once payment rails mature (econ-006 stream 3).
Gates M4 competition entry in the settled design.

modules.title: Point-source modules (referral, giveaway, signup, social earn)
modules.summary: The other point sources that feed M3 (lifetime + spendable) but NEVER M2 local. Signup bonus from day 1; referral, giveaway and social-share earn paths built early.
details: SIGNUP BONUS: from day 1 a user joins the platform. Goes to M3c spendable (and M3b lifetime), NEVER M2 local, so bragging rights stay pure.
REFERRAL: invites earn the referrer M3 points when the friend joins/plays. Early build - core acquisition.
GIVEAWAY: promotional/lootbox-style surprises (econ-001), feed M3 only.
SOCIAL EARN: share-linked small earn paths to soften the buy-to-join moment (econ-005).
Rule: ALL of these feed M3 (lifetime + spendable), never M2 local and never M3a pure. M2 stays strictly verified gameplay.

rules: M1 never calls M3: the game and rewards are separated. The game does not know how points work.
M4 needs no M5: competitions stand alone from sponsor; escrow is an optional plugin.
Local (M2) never diluted: no multiplier, no purchase, no bonus, no giveaway, no referral on local points.
Multiplier only at M3 flow-up: 2x/3x/4x touches M3b lifetime + M3c spendable, never M2 or M3a.
Everything slots together by source tag ('Ludo', 'Ayo Olopon', 'signup_bonus', 'referral').
Modular + pluggable: each module is interchangeable and game-agnostic; no module is tailored to a single game.

Extensible: M1-M7 cover the current roadmap. Any genuinely new domain (community/forum, support, profile, etc.) becomes a NEW module (M8+) recorded here FIRST. A feature is never 'unmodular' - it either slots into an existing module or earns a new one.
implementationOrder: 1. M1 + M2 + M3 for Ludo: Ludo whole, testable now. Per-game local PDA (program tweak + redeploy), pure base writes, multiplier at M3 flow-up, 3 global ledgers. Test it.
2. M6 monthly subscription (after M1-M3): the money engine - Active Tier multiplier at flow-up, spendable drain.
3. M7 point sources: signup bonus (day 1), referral, giveaway, social earn.
4. M4 competitions game-agnostic (after M1-M3 stable), with pluggable payout (airtime / manual / escrow).
5. M5 sponsor escrow plugin (program proof already exists) - attached only when a brand wants an escrowed prize.
